name: Attio
description: Attio is a customizable, AI-powered CRM built on flexible data objects (people, companies, deals) for go-to-market teams.
gating_notes: Access tokens can be generated for free on every plan including the Free tier ('API and webhook access' is checked across Free, Plus, Pro, Enterprise). Only workspace admins can generate/manage tokens (non-admins must ask an admin), but there is no paid-plan or sales-contact gate on API access itself.
mcp_notes: Official first-party hosted remote MCP server at https://mcp.attio.com/mcp, documented at docs.attio.com/mcp/overview. Uses OAuth login (no API key needed), exposes 50+ tools across records (people/companies/deals/custom objects), lists/pipelines, notes/tasks/comments, search (incl. semantic search over notes/recordings), reporting, and workspace administration; reads are auto-approved, writes require confirmation.
